title: EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events
abstract: arXiv:2610.40166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. I

translated_title: EventSeeColor：学习从单色事件中重建彩色图像
translated_abstract: 事件相机能够在具有挑战性的光照条件下捕捉视觉亮度变化。然而，传统的基于事件的图像重建方法以灰度强度为目标，生成的图像不包含场景颜色。颜色能够区分强度相似的表面，从事件中重建颜色可以揭示重建灰度图像无法表达的外观差异。尽管单色事件相机并不直接测量颜色，但其事件触发模式取决于表面反射率、光照以及传感器的光谱响应，这些模式中可能包含支持颜色重建的线索。本文提出了 EventSeeColor，该方法利用事件重建的灰度图像与对齐的事件共同引导扩散着色模型：由灰度衍生的语义上下文支持颜色推理，而区域均衡的色度监督和局部 RGB 精化则改善了颜色分布、亮度和纹理。
tldr: 提出 EventSeeColor 方法，利用事件重建的灰度图像与对齐事件共同引导扩散着色模型，首次从单色事件相机数据中重建出场景颜色，突破了传统事件图像重建仅能输出灰度的局限。
en_tdlr: EventSeeColor jointly leverages event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to guide a diffusion colorizer, enabling color reconstruction from monochrome event camera data beyond the grayscale limits of traditional event-based reconstruction.
